claims.explanation: SB-431542 selectively inhibits TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling, and sensitivity is strongly associated with intact TGF-beta pathway components, particularly SMAD4 and TGFBR2, as well as activation of the pathway via oncogenic drivers like mutant KRAS and BRAF. Lines with mutations in SMAD4 or loss of TGFBR2 are protected, while those with wild-type pathway and high TGF-beta signaling are sensitized.

features.basis: SMAD4 mutation disrupts TGF-beta signaling, reducing dependence on the pathway
TGFBR2 loss abrogates TGF-beta signaling, conferring resistance
KRAS mutant lines are enriched among sensitive lines, possibly via TGF-beta crosstalk
BRAF mutant lines are enriched among sensitive lines
High expression of the drug target ALK5 increases sensitivity
High expression of the drug target ALK7 increases sensitivity
High SMAD3 expression indicates active TGF-beta signaling
High SMAD2 expression indicates active TGF-beta signaling
TP53 mutation is common in resistant lines, though not specific
PTEN mutation appears in several resistant lines
NF1 mutation appears in several resistant lines
CDKN2A mutation appears in several resistant lines
